title: Anamorphic projection
blurb: Project one live interactive HTML webpage from a virtual cinema projector across a five-step 3D staircase and gallery corner, then orbit away to see it fracture across the steps and compare where updateElementGeometry() puts the hit box.
question: Can one live interactive HTML element be projected across a multi-plane 3D staircase and gallery corner so it snaps flat at the projector's sweet spot, and what happens to updateElementGeometry() when one element spans twelve non-coplanar faces?
